name: Manaboshi Akira
source:
He used to have a detached and cool attitude, but this incident has (forcibly) made him become more passionate.

He doesn't have many hobbies, but if he had to say one, it would be online games. He practically lives alone, so he can handle most aspects of daily life.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/048/index.html]official website[/url]]
